Do not hand-edit: change the source segment or the authored notes in the generator and regenerate, or the capture lane stops being the journey's own path and §H.1's provenance claim stops being true. `--check` fails CI-style if the two have drifted.
_comment_derivation: Kept: every step of X01 up to and including its last capture (index 384 of 1202), minus note/defect/probe_cell/save_out and the four pacing asserts. 220 of 1203 steps survive. Step ids carry their origin in `_derived_from`.
_comment_seeding: Run this into the SAME run directory as the logic lanes. Its `seed_save` steps resolve `run://` against that directory's saves, so a capture lane run anywhere else has no chapter to load and will stop at its first seed.
_comment_cost: After S01C this is the cheapest capture lane in the run, and by a wide margin the biggest saving the split produces: a 1,203-step segment becomes a load and a tab walk. Every frame is class B -- a menu tab is a state the shell reaches from any save, on a button press. §H names X01 on the mandatory continuous-evidence list; the input matrix that made it high-risk is a LOGIC concern and stays in the logic lane, which is the split working exactly as intended.
